variants.headline: Food belongs at the centre of politics
variants.body: There is not enough food in {colony}. People are hungry, and the political debate must answer that simple, urgent fact. Our principles demand attention.

variants.headline: A principle measured in meals
variants.body: Food is insufficient and people are hungry in {colony}. Political principles should be judged by what they mean for those people. Our principles demand attention.

variants.headline: The political question hunger poses
variants.body: People are going hungry in {colony} because food is insufficient. Any political argument should keep their needs at its centre. Our principles demand attention.
